scientific_integrity: A fully stated explicit construction and a matching two-output packing obstruction establish the theorem for every integer n at least 3; finite direct-output and independent clique checks are auxiliary. The result has undergone the documented self-review; no independent external audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only binary words of weight exactly two, one arbitrary deletion and n at least 3. The study does not determine the full class of optimizers, multi-deletion or general-weight optima. An unindexed equivalent earlier statement cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact single-deletion code capacity at binary Hamming weight two
